commonTraps: 名词形式是abandonment，不是*abandonation
examTips: 常见搭配：abandon a plan/hope/idea
情感/励志类文章常见

gaokaoExamples.en: She abandoned her plan to study abroad due to family reasons.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 由于家庭原因，她放弃了出国留学的计划。

gaokaoExamples.en: We should never abandon our dreams, no matter how difficult things get.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 无论多困难，我们都不应该放弃梦想。

confusingWords.difference: give up为口语表达；abandon更书面正式
desert强调对有责任照顾对象的抛弃，abandon更泛用

abandon.memoryTip: a-band-on：一支乐队(band)离开了舞台(on) → 放弃、抛弃
abandon.usageNote: abandon sth. / abandon doing sth.（不用abandon to do）

commonTraps: ability to do sth.（不是 ability of doing sth.）
examTips: 写作高频：have the ability to do sth.
常与develop, improve, enhance搭配

gaokaoExamples.en: Reading widely can help students develop their ability to think critically.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 广泛阅读有助于学生培养批判性思维能力。

gaokaoExamples.en: She showed great ability in solving complex problems.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 她在解决复杂问题方面展现出了极强的能力。

collocationItems.phrase: have the ability to do sth.
to the best of one's ability

confusingWords.difference: capability偏指客观具备的潜力；ability偏指实际表现出的能力
skill强调通过练习掌握的具体技能；ability更宏观

ability.memoryTip: able（有能力的）+ -ity（名词后缀）= ability（能力）
ability.usageNote: ability TO do sth. ✓  ability OF doing ✗

commonTraps: 名词achievement注意拼写（中间是ie，不是ei）
examTips: 写作超高频：achieve one's goal/dream/success
常考励志类语境

gaokaoExamples.en: With hard work and determination, you can achieve anything you set your mind to.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 只要勤奋努力、坚定意志，你就能实现任何你下定决心要做的事。

gaokaoExamples.en: The project team finally achieved their goal after months of hard work.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 经过数月努力，项目团队终于实现了他们的目标。

confusingWords.difference: accomplish强调成功完成某项具体任务；achieve更侧重实现目标或梦想
attain多用于书面语，achieve更常用

achieve.usageNote: achieve sth. 直接接宾语，不用achieve to do

commonTraps: affect是动词；effect通常是名词——高考超高频易混点
examTips: affect + 宾语（直接接名词）
不要写成 have affect on（正确：have an effect on）

gaokaoExamples.en: Air pollution seriously affects people's health, especially in large cities.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 空气污染严重影响人们的健康，尤其是在大城市。

gaokaoExamples.en: The weather can greatly affect our mood and productivity.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 天气会极大地影响我们的情绪和工作效率。

confusingWords.meaning: n. 效果，影响；v.（正式）使产生
confusingWords.difference: affect是动词：sth. affects sb.；effect通常是名词：have an effect on

confusingWords.meaning: v./n. 影响（更广义，潜移默化）
confusingWords.difference: influence强调潜移默化的影响；affect更强调直接的（通常负面）作用

affect.memoryTip: affect打头A = Action（动作）→ 动词；effect打头E = End result → 名词
affect.usageNote: affect作动词：sth. affects sb./sth.；effect作名词：have an effect on

commonTraps: approach to doing sth.（介词to后接动名词）
examTips: 写作高频：a new approach to...
既作名词（方法）又作动词（靠近/处理）

gaokaoExamples.en: Teachers should adopt different approaches to teaching students with different learning styles.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 教师应采用不同方法来教导学习方式各异的学生。

gaokaoExamples.en: As the exam approached, students began to feel more nervous.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 随着考试临近，学生们开始感到更加紧张。

confusingWords.difference: method指具体系统的步骤；approach更侧重整体思路和角度
way最口语；approach书面性更强

approach.memoryTip: ap-proach：向前(ap-)靠近，像reach向前伸出手
approach.usageNote: 作名词：an approach to doing sth.；作动词：approach sb./sth.（不需要介词）

commonTraps: attitude to/towards sth. 两个介词都正确
examTips: 写作高频：one's attitude towards/to...
阅读理解常考作者对某话题的attitude

gaokaoExamples.en: A positive attitude towards learning can greatly improve your academic performance.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 对学习持积极的态度可以极大地提升学业成绩。

gaokaoExamples.en: The author's attitude towards the use of technology in schools is clearly positive.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 作者对学校使用技术持明显积极的态度。

confusingWords.difference: opinion更强调理性观点；attitude更强调情感倾向
view偏理性观点；attitude偏主观态度和心理倾向

attitude.memoryTip: attitude（态度）≈ altitude（高度）：你的态度决定你的高度
attitude.usageNote: attitude TO/TOWARDS sth. 均可；后接名词或动名词

commonTraps: benefit from sth.（受益于）；benefit sb.（使某人受益，动词直接接宾语）
examTips: 写作必备：the benefits of...
常与advantage对比

gaokaoExamples.en: Regular exercise has many benefits for both physical and mental health.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 定期锻炼对身心健康都有很多好处。

gaokaoExamples.en: Students can benefit greatly from participating in after-school activities.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 学生参加课外活动可以获益匪浅。

confusingWords.difference: advantage强调比较中的优势；benefit强调带来的好处
profit偏指经济收益；benefit更广泛

benefit.memoryTip: bene（好的，拉丁语）+ fit（合适）= 好处
benefit.usageNote: benefit sb.（动词直接接宾语）；benefit from sth.（受益于）

commonTraps: face/meet a challenge（面对/迎接挑战）；be faced with challenges
examTips: 写作必备：面对挑战、迎接挑战
高考作文常见话题

gaokaoExamples.en: Young people today face many challenges, such as academic pressure and career competition.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 当今年轻人面临许多挑战，如学业压力和职业竞争。

gaokaoExamples.en: Meeting new challenges is an important part of growing up.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 迎接新挑战是成长的重要组成部分。

confusingWords.difference: difficulty偏中性；challenge带积极含义，暗示可以克服
obstacle强调阻碍性；challenge强调需要努力应对的考验

challenge.memoryTip: 想象：challenge = change + llenge → 迎接变化才是真正的挑战
challenge.usageNote: face/meet/accept a challenge；challenging作形容词：a challenging task

commonTraps: be concerned about（担心）vs be concerned with（涉及/关于）——高频考点
examTips: 高考阅读常见：express concern about...
as far as...is concerned（就...而言）是写作好用句型

gaokaoExamples.en: There is growing concern about the impact of social media on teenagers' mental health.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 人们对社交媒体对青少年心理健康影响的担忧日益增加。

gaokaoExamples.en: As far as environmental protection is concerned, everyone has a responsibility.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 就环境保护而言，每个人都有责任。

confusingWords.difference: worry偏口语；concern更正式，且含义更广（不只担心，还有关心）
relate to作'涉及'解时与concern with类似，但更口语

concern.memoryTip: con（共同）+ cern（辨别，拉丁语）→ 共同关注辨别的事 → 关心，担心
concern.usageNote: be concerned ABOUT（担忧）；be concerned WITH（关于，涉及）

commonTraps: consider doing（考虑做）不是 consider to do；consider sb./sth. (to be) adj.
examTips: 写作高频：考虑方案/问题时用consider
consider后接动名词，不接不定式

gaokaoExamples.en: You should consider all the factors before making an important decision.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 在做重要决定之前，你应该考虑所有因素。

gaokaoExamples.en: Many people consider exercise to be the best way to stay healthy.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 许多人认为锻炼是保持健康的最佳方式。

confusingWords.difference: considerable=相当大的；considerate=体贴周到的；注意拼写区分
think about更口语；consider更正式

consider.memoryTip: consider → 仔细观察星星（拉丁：sider=星星）→ 仔细思考 → 考虑

commonTraps: contribute to sth./doing（to是介词，后接名词或动名词）
examTips: 写作必备：contribute to the development of...
阅读理解中常考'什么因素导致了结果'

gaokaoExamples.en: Everyone should contribute to protecting the environment.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 每个人都应该为保护环境做出贡献。

gaokaoExamples.en: Lack of sleep can contribute to poor academic performance.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 睡眠不足会导致学习成绩下降。

confusingWords.difference: contribute to表示是原因之一（间接）；cause更直接
devote强调长期投入；contribute强调做出的贡献

contribute.memoryTip: con（共同）+ tribute（给予，贡品）→ 共同给予 → 贡献

commonTraps: cultural（形容词）和cultured（有教养的）注意区分
examTips: 高考热门话题：中西文化对比、传统文化、文化交流
cultural diversity（文化多样性）高频词组

gaokaoExamples.en: Understanding different cultures helps us become more open-minded and tolerant.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 了解不同文化有助于我们变得更加开明和宽容。

gaokaoExamples.en: Chinese traditional culture has a long history of more than 5,000 years.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 中国传统文化有着超过5000年的悠久历史。

wordFamily.meaning: 有教养的；有文化修养的

confusingWords.difference: civilization强调整体文明形态；culture侧重精神、风俗、艺术层面
custom指具体风俗习惯；culture是更广泛的文化概念

culture.memoryTip: cult（精神崇拜）+ ure → 人类精神信仰的产物 → 文化
culture.usageNote: culture通常可数（a culture）也可不可数（Chinese culture）

commonTraps: development（名词）注意拼写，不是*developement
examTips: 写作超高频：develop a habit/skill, develop the economy
developing countries（发展中国家）高考必备

gaokaoExamples.en: China has developed rapidly in the past few decades.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 中国在过去几十年里发展迅速。

gaokaoExamples.en: Reading regularly can help you develop critical thinking skills.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 定期阅读有助于培养批判性思维能力。

confusingWords.meaning: 生长；增长（更自然的过程）
confusingWords.difference: grow强调自然增长；develop强调有意识地发展
improve强调变得更好；develop强调从无到有或规模扩大

develop.memoryTip: de + velop（→ envelope信封）→ 从信封中展开 → 发展
develop.usageNote: develop作不及物：The situation is developing. 作及物：develop a new product

commonTraps: affect（v.影响）vs effect（n.效果）——高考超高频易混词
examTips: have an effect on = affect；写作中常互换
side effects（副作用）高频词组

gaokaoExamples.en: Regular exercise has a positive effect on both physical and mental health.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 定期锻炼对身心健康有积极影响。

gaokaoExamples.en: The new policy has had little effect on reducing traffic congestion.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 新政策对缓解交通拥堵几乎没有效果。

confusingWords.difference: affect是动词；effect通常是名词，固定搭配：have an effect on
result强调最终结果；effect更强调影响/效果这一状态

effect.memoryTip: effect打头E = End result（最终结果）→ 名词；affect打头A = Action → 动词
effect.usageNote: effect通常是名词：an effect on；affect是动词：affect sth.

commonTraps: make efforts to do（注意复数）；spare no effort in/to do sth.（不遗余力）
examTips: 写作必备：make great efforts to do sth.
常搭配：spare no effort, put effort into

gaokaoExamples.en: Success comes from making consistent efforts rather than relying on talent alone.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 成功来自持续的努力，而不仅仅依靠天赋。

gaokaoExamples.en: Despite their best efforts, they couldn't finish the project on time.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 尽管付出了最大努力，他们仍然无法按时完成项目。

confusingWords.difference: attempt更强调行动的尝试；effort更强调投入的力气
try是动词；effort是名词，常与make搭配

effort.memoryTip: ef（out努力地）+ fort（拉丁语：力量）→ 努力
effort.usageNote: make an effort/make efforts；spare no effort in doing / to do sth.

commonTraps: encourage sb. TO do sth.（不是encourage sb. doing sth.）
examTips: 写作高频：鼓励他人时用encourage
encourage healthy habits（鼓励好习惯）也常见

gaokaoExamples.en: Parents should encourage their children to pursue their own interests.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 父母应该鼓励孩子追求自己的兴趣。

gaokaoExamples.en: The teacher's words of encouragement motivated the students to work harder.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 老师的鼓励话语激励学生更加努力。

confusingWords.difference: motivate更强调激发内在动力；encourage更强调给予外在支持和信心
inspire更强调带来灵感或深层触动；encourage更日常化

encourage.memoryTip: en（使）+ courage（勇气）→ 给予勇气 → 鼓励
encourage.usageNote: encourage sb. TO do sth.（不是encourage sb. doing sth.）

commonTraps: 注意拼写：environment（不是*enviroment）；environmental是形容词
examTips: 高考热门话题：环境保护、可持续发展
environmental pollution（环境污染）超高频

gaokaoExamples.en: We must take action to protect the environment for future generations.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 我们必须采取行动保护环境，为子孙后代负责。

gaokaoExamples.en: A good learning environment can greatly improve students' performance.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 良好的学习环境可以极大地提升学生的表现。

confusingWords.difference: surroundings指物理周围环境；environment更广，可指自然/社会环境
nature专指自然界；environment包括自然和非自然环境

environment.memoryTip: environ（包围）+ ment → 包围我们的事物 → 环境
environment.usageNote: the environment（特指自然环境）；a work environment（工作环境，泛指）

commonTraps: an experience（一次经历，可数）vs experience（经验，不可数）——高频考点
examTips: 写作高频：have/gain experience; a memorable experience
可数与不可数含义不同是考点

gaokaoExamples.en: Travelling abroad gives young people valuable experience in dealing with different cultures.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 出国旅行给年轻人提供了宝贵的跨文化经验。

gaokaoExamples.en: Volunteering is an unforgettable experience that can broaden your horizons.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 志愿服务是一段难忘的经历，能开阔你的视野。

confusingWords.difference: 两者同根，但experiment指科学实验；experience指生活经历/经验
knowledge是理论知识；experience是实践获得的经验

experience.memoryTip: ex（出）+ per（尝试）+ ience → 亲身尝试 → 经历、经验
experience.usageNote: experience（n.）：可数=经历(an experience)；不可数=经验(gain experience)

commonTraps: focus on（专注于），介词用on；名词用法：the focus of/on
examTips: 写作高频：focus on key points
阅读理解常考文章讨论重点

gaokaoExamples.en: Students should focus on understanding concepts rather than just memorizing facts.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 学生应专注于理解概念，而不是死记硬背。

gaokaoExamples.en: The report focuses on the effects of climate change on coastal cities.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 该报告重点关注气候变化对沿海城市的影响。

confusingWords.difference: concentrate on更强调意志力集中；focus on更广，可指方向/重点
center on强调中心；focus on更动态，也指关注重点

focus.memoryTip: 光学焦点(focus) → 聚焦，集中
focus.usageNote: focus ON sth.（介词用on）；名词：the focus is on...

commonTraps: improvement是名词，注意拼写（不是*improval）
examTips: 写作超高频：improve one's English/skills/health
常搭配greatly, significantly等副词

gaokaoExamples.en: Reading widely is one of the best ways to improve your vocabulary and writing skills.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 广泛阅读是提高词汇量和写作技能的最佳途径之一。

gaokaoExamples.en: The government has taken measures to improve the quality of public education.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 政府已采取措施提高公共教育质量。

confusingWords.difference: develop强调从无到有的发展；improve强调在已有基础上变得更好
enhance偏正式；improve更通用

improve.memoryTip: im（进入）+ prove（证实）→ 不断证实提升 → 改善
improve.usageNote: improve sth.（及物）/ improve（不及物）：My English is improving.

commonTraps: increase by（增加了多少）vs increase to（增加到多少）
examTips: 图表题必备：a sharp/steady increase in...
写作：increase in number/size

gaokaoExamples.en: The number of people using the internet has increased significantly in recent years.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 近年来使用互联网的人数大幅增加。

gaokaoExamples.en: There has been a steady increase in the demand for electric vehicles.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 对电动汽车的需求一直在稳步增加。

confusingWords.difference: rise是不及物：prices rise；increase可及物：increase prices
grow强调自然增长；increase强调数量/程度的上升

increase.memoryTip: in（向内）+ crease（折叠）→ 折叠层数增多 → 增加
increase.usageNote: increase BY（增加了多少）vs increase TO（增加到多少）

commonTraps: have an influence ON（不是about）；under the influence OF
examTips: 写作：have a positive/negative influence on...
influence作动词时直接接宾语

gaokaoExamples.en: Parents have a great influence on their children's values and behavior.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 父母对子女的价值观和行为有很大影响。

gaokaoExamples.en: Social media has greatly influenced the way people communicate with each other.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 社交媒体极大地影响了人们相互沟通的方式。

confusingWords.meaning: v. 影响（多指负面，直接作用）
confusingWords.difference: affect是动词，强调直接作用；influence可名可动，强调潜移默化
effect是名词，指影响的结果；influence强调影响力本身

influence.memoryTip: in（进入）+ flu（流）+ ence → 流入别人内心 → 影响
influence.usageNote: influence sb./sth.（动词直接接宾语）；have an influence ON sb./sth.

commonTraps: involve doing（涉及做某事）不是involve to do；be involved in（参与/卷入）
examTips: 写作：The project involves...（该项目涉及...）
be involved in a community activity（参与活动）高频

gaokaoExamples.en: The study involved more than 500 students from different schools.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 这项研究涉及来自不同学校的500多名学生。

gaokaoExamples.en: Being involved in volunteer work can improve your social skills.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 参与志愿工作可以提高你的社交技能。

confusingWords.difference: include强调是整体的一部分；involve强调必然要做或参与
contain更具体指容器内容；involve更抽象，指复杂关系

involve.memoryTip: in（里面）+ volve（卷）→ 卷入其中 → 涉及，参与
involve.usageNote: involve DOING（涉及做某事）；be involved IN（参与某事）

commonTraps: knowledge是不可数名词，不能说*a knowledge；注意拼写（kno-wledge）
examTips: 写作高频：gain/acquire knowledge
to the best of my knowledge（据我所知）写作好用

gaokaoExamples.en: Education provides us with the knowledge and skills needed for future success.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 教育为我们提供未来成功所需的知识和技能。

gaokaoExamples.en: To the best of my knowledge, he has never been abroad.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 据我所知，他从未出过国。

collocationItems.phrase: to the best of my knowledge

confusingWords.difference: information指具体事实性信息；knowledge更广，指系统化理解
knowledge是已知的事实原理；wisdom是运用知识的能力和判断力

knowledge.memoryTip: know（知道）+ ledge（梯子/边缘）→ 站在知识的台阶上 → 知识
knowledge.usageNote: knowledge是不可数名词；to one's knowledge（据某人所知）

commonTraps: opportunity TO do sth.（不是of doing）；seize/take the opportunity（抓住机会）
examTips: 写作必备：have/seize/take the opportunity to do...
provide sb. with an opportunity to do sth.高频句型

gaokaoExamples.en: Studying abroad gives students an opportunity to experience different cultures firsthand.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 出国留学给学生提供了第一手体验不同文化的机会。

gaokaoExamples.en: We should seize every opportunity to improve ourselves.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 我们应该抓住每一个机会来提升自己。

confusingWords.difference: chance更口语，也有'可能性'含义；opportunity更正式，强调有利时机
possibility强调可能性；opportunity强调行动的时机

opportunity.memoryTip: port（港口）→ 在合适时机进港 → opportunit-y（机会）
opportunity.usageNote: an opportunity TO do sth.（不定式）；an opportunity FOR sth.（名词）

commonTraps: perform well/badly（表现好/差）；performance（名词）注意拼写（-ance结尾）
examTips: perform a task/operation/experiment（执行任务/手术/实验）在阅读中常见

gaokaoExamples.en: The students performed a traditional Chinese dance at the school festival.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 学生们在学校节日上表演了一段中国传统舞蹈。

gaokaoExamples.en: The team performed well under pressure and won the championship.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 这支队伍在压力下表现出色，赢得了冠军。

confusingWords.difference: act强调扮演角色；perform更广，包括演出、执行等
conduct多用于实验、研究、音乐指挥；perform更通用

perform.memoryTip: per（完全）+ form（形式）→ 完全按形式执行 → 表演，完成
perform.usageNote: perform sth.（执行某事）；perform well（表现好）

commonTraps: positive effect ON（不是about）；be positive ABOUT sth.（确信）
examTips: 写作必备对比词：positive vs negative
have a positive effect/impact on... 超高频

gaokaoExamples.en: Keeping a positive attitude is essential for overcoming difficulties in life.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 保持积极的态度对于克服生活中的困难至关重要。

gaokaoExamples.en: Social media can have both positive and negative effects on young people.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 社交媒体对年轻人既有积极影响，也有消极影响。

confusingWords.difference: optimistic侧重心理状态的乐观；positive更广，可指积极、肯定等
active强调行动上的积极；positive更强调态度和方向

positive.memoryTip: pos（放置，拉丁语）→ 坚定地把好的事物放置好 → 积极，肯定
positive.usageNote: positive effect ON（不是about）；be positive ABOUT sth.（确信）

commonTraps: prevent sb. FROM doing sth.（from不能省略）
examTips: 写作高频：take measures to prevent...
常考'预防疾病/事故/污染'语境

gaokaoExamples.en: Regular hand washing is an effective way to prevent the spread of infectious diseases.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 定期洗手是预防传染病传播的有效方式。

gaokaoExamples.en: The fence was built to prevent animals from entering the farmland.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 建造围栏是为了防止动物进入农田。

confusingWords.difference: avoid是主语自己主动回避；prevent是外力阻止别人或某事
stop sb. from doing与prevent同义但更口语；prevent更正式

prevent.memoryTip: pre（提前）+ vent（来）→ 提前来阻止 → 预防
prevent.usageNote: prevent sb./sth. FROM doing sth.（from不能省略）

commonTraps: provide sb. WITH sth. 或 provide sth. FOR sb.（两种结构都正确）
examTips: 写作超高频：provide opportunities/information/support

gaokaoExamples.en: The library provides students with access to thousands of books and online resources.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 图书馆为学生提供获取数千本书籍和在线资源的途径。

gaokaoExamples.en: The program is designed to provide free meals for children from low-income families.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 该项目旨在为低收入家庭的儿童提供免费餐食。

confusingWords.meaning: 提供（主动给予，可被拒绝）
confusingWords.difference: offer更强调主动提出，可以被接受或拒绝；provide更强调供应
supply强调大量持续供应；provide更通用

provide.memoryTip: pro（前）+ vide（看，拉丁语）→ 提前看到需要 → 提供
provide.usageNote: provide sb. WITH sth.（with不可省）；provide sth. FOR sb.

commonTraps: suggest doing（建议做）不是suggest to do；suggest that sb. (should) do sth.（虚拟语气）
examTips: 高考超高频：suggest that...（建议/暗示...）
注意suggest表'暗示'时和'建议'含义不同

gaokaoExamples.en: The research suggests that regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 研究表明，定期锻炼可以降低患心脏病的风险。

gaokaoExamples.en: I suggest that we (should) start the meeting earlier than planned.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 我建议我们比原计划提前开会。

confusingWords.difference: recommend更正式，且后接名词/动名词/that从句；suggest更广泛
advise sb. to do sth.（动词不定式）；suggest不能接不定式

suggest.memoryTip: sug（sub=下面）+ gest（携带）→ 从下面带出想法 → 建议，暗示
suggest.usageNote: suggest DOING ✓；suggest TO DO ✗；suggest that + (should) + 动词原形

commonTraps: values（复数）= 价值观；value（单数/不可数）= 价值
examTips: 写作高频：the value of...; traditional values（传统价值观）
高考文化类阅读常见

gaokaoExamples.en: Education helps young people develop the right values and attitudes towards life.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 教育帮助年轻人形成正确的人生价值观和态度。

gaokaoExamples.en: Travelling can broaden your horizons and help you appreciate the value of different cultures.
gaokaoExamples.zh: 旅行可以开阔你的视野，帮助你欣赏不同文化的价值。

confusingWords.difference: worth作名词/形容词：be worth doing；value更多用作名词或动词
price是金钱价格；value更广，指内在/精神价值

value.memoryTip: val（来自拉丁语valere=强壮/有价值）→ value（价值）
value.usageNote: value sth.（动词：重视）；value（名词：价值）；values（复数：价值观）
